name: watch-my-ram
description: Warns when RAM + swap passes a threshold, lists live Claude sessions and orphan dev processes, and flags parallel test runs. Never blocks or kills.

threshold_gb.title: Memory alert threshold (GB)
threshold_gb.description: The band turns red when RAM in use + swap used goes above this many GB. Leave empty for automatic (1.25 × installed RAM); set 0 to return to automatic later.
